# Next Farm Bio Sciences - Comprehensive Biotechnology Protocols & Full Technical Monograph

## 1. Enterprise Overview & Quality Standards
Next Farm Bio Sciences is an Indian aquaculture biotechnology manufacturer headquartered in New Autonagar, Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, 520010, India. All biological formulations are manufactured under strict ISO 9001:2015 quality assurance protocols, approved by the Coastal Aquaculture Authority (CAA), Government of India, and guaranteed 100% free from banned antibiotics (Chloramphenicol, Nitrofurans, Tetracyclines free).

## 2. Pathogen & Water Parameter Treatment Protocols

### Protocol A: White Gut Syndrome & Enteric Vibrio Infection
- Etiology: Enteric pathogen colonization (pathogenic Vibrio, microsporidian Enterocytozoon hepatopenaei / EHP), toxic cyanobacterial ingestion, sloughing of midgut microvilli lining.
- Symptoms: White fecal strands floating on check trays and pond leeward edges, pale hepatopancreas, trailing feces, and sharp feed drop.
- Targeted Formulations:
  1. next gut: Multi-strain enteric probiotic (Citrobacter, Lactobacillus sporogenes, Bifidobacteria, S. cerevisiae, 10 Billion CFU/g). Coat 15-20 mL/kg feed across all daily meals for 5 consecutive days.
  2. next viro nill: Microbial sediment conditioner (Bacillus subtilis, B. licheniformis, Pediococcus acidilactici, 5 Billion CFU/ml). Broadcast 1.0 L/Acre in morning aeration to suppress horizontal reinfection.

### Protocol B: Toxic Ammonia (NH3 / TAN), Nitrite (NO2), & Hydrogen Sulfide
- Etiology: Nitrogenous waste accumulation from uneaten commercial feed, high stocking density, and anaerobic benthic breakdown.
- Symptoms: Total Ammonia Nitrogen > 0.5 ppm, Nitrite > 1.0 ppm, nocturnal shrimp piping, black bottom mud, and foul rotten egg H2S odor.
- Targeted Formulations:
  1. next converter: Heterotrophic nitrification and sulfide oxidation consortium (Bacillus polymyxa, Candida sp., 4 Billion CFU/ml). Broadcast 2.0-3.0 L/Acre in front of operating aerators.
  2. next sludge: Fungal-enzymatic consortium (Rhizopus, Cunninghemella, Chrysosporium, Mucor, Aspergillus, Chitinase enzymes). Apply 2.0 kg/Acre directly onto central drainage pits.
  3. next remedy: Algicidal microbial equilibrium consortium (Candida sp., Rhodococcus, Arthrobacter, 5 Billion CFU/ml). Broadcast 1.0-2.0 L/Acre to digest surface organic scum and stabilize pH swings.

### Protocol C: White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV) Biosecurity & Vibrio Red Disease
- Etiology: Nimaviridae White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV) triggered by sudden temperature shifts, and virulent Vibrio parahaemolyticus / V. harveyi strains.
- Symptoms: White calcified spots (0.5–2.0 mm) inside the carapace, reddish pleopods, discolored hepatopancreas, glowing night water, and rapid mortality.
- Targeted Formulations:
  1. next vibriosis: Targeted lactic acid bacteria and actinomycetes (Lactobacillus plantarum, L. curvatus, Pediococcus acidilactici, Streptomyces griseus, 8 Billion CFU/ml). Broadcast 1.5-2.0 L/Acre in pond water and top-dress 10-15 mL/kg onto feed.
  2. next viro nill: High-potency biological sediment sanitizer (5 Billion CFU/ml). Deprives viral vectors of benthic detritus and breaks horizontal transmission cycles.

### Protocol D: Soft Shell Syndrome & Molting Cramps
- Etiology: Imbalance in bioavailable ionic Calcium:Magnesium ratios, low salinity water (0-10 ppt), and lunar ecdysis stress.
- Symptoms: Carapaces remain soft > 4 hours post-molt, white opaque muscle cramps, and cannibalism mortalities.
- Targeted Formulations:
  1. next min: 100% bioavailable ionic macromineral supplement (Ca 22%, Mg 11%, P 4.5%, K 3%, Trace Zn, Mn, Fe, Cu, Se). Broadcast 5.0-10.0 kg/Acre during nighttime peak molting (6:00 PM - 2:00 AM).
  2. next softner: Biological organic acid chelation complex (Acetobacter, Arthrobacter, Azotobacter). Broadcast 2.0 L/Acre in hard borewell water (>300 ppm CaCO3) to unlock bound calcium and magnesium carbonates.

### Protocol E: Growth Acceleration & Live Food Plankton Blooms
- Targeted Formulations:
  1. next food pro: Feed-grade bio-nutrition probiotic (Bacillus subtilis, Lactobacillus acidophilus, Enterococcus faecium, Beta-glucans, MOS, B-vitamins, 6 Billion CFU/g). Mix 3-5 g/kg feed for superior FCR.
  2. next pro plus: Botanical amino acid and selective Bacillus complex (20% active extract, 3 Billion CFU/ml). Multiplies natural rotifers, copepods, and zooplankton in nursery ponds.
  3. next pro: Dual-action multi-strain beneficial bacteria (Bacillus subtilis, B. licheniformis, L. sporogenes, B. megaterium, 15 Billion CFU/ml). Universal water purification and gut colonization.
